findings.title: Reference template exceeds 2500-leaf cap; validateWorld throws
findings.fix: Base 2/m², path carpet 80/m², trunk carpet r1.5 at 100/m², drift band 1x20 m at 30/m² (≈2347); assert expected count ≤ 2300 per template in generate.test.ts

findings.title: Drop-off and up-step detection impossible on bilinear 5 cm grid
findings.fix: Evaluate steps analytically in heightAt (grid + exact step offsets); treat a wheel up-step > climbStepM as a solid collision; add up-curb collision test

findings.title: Detection camera uses stale depth, phone uses same-frame depth
findings.fix: Render a fresh depth map from C_true(t0) at each detection capture and attach it

findings.title: Ideal preset yields 100 Hz detection frames; 'same tick' contradicts §16 order
findings.fix: Add detectPeriodMs=333 in all presets; next capture = max(delivery, lastCapture+detectPeriodMs); ideal delivery at next step's (1)

findings.title: AR origin height ambiguous; should be camera's initial 3D position
findings.fix: T_ar maps initial camera position (floor at y≈-cameraHeightM) with random yaw; ideal identity; add realistic floor test

findings.title: Projection round-trip test metric/conditions undefined
findings.fix: Horizontal distance to true centre; ideal, full-res depth, curl 0, isolated leaf at 1–2 m; LiDAR ≤3 cm, floor ray ≤1 cm, |y|≤3 cm

findings.title: Detector test asserts v > 384 for leaf ahead; wrong beyond 0.82 m
carryDump detection rule ambiguous (no step before start)
findings.fix: Static check at load: Brain && Brain.prototype.setPile && DEFAULT_AUTOPILOT.capacity → 'brain', else 'shim'; amber note if brain never empties a full scoop in 30 s

findings.title: Claim that Reset picks up brain edits is unverified/likely wrong (module cache, HMR propagation)
findings.fix: Self-accept HMR in brainAdapter, mark 'Brain code changed; press Reset', Reset re-imports with cache-bust; unit test reload with fake modules

findings.title: git status clean under apps/expo-app unworkable with concurrent brain agent
findings.fix: Check that the sim task's own staged changes/commits never touch apps/expo-app; record baseline; brain-agent changes are not failures

findings.title: Manual WASD ignored while controller <select> keeps focus
findings.fix: Blur select and focus canvas on switch to manual; manual.ts ignores only text inputs/textarea/contentEditable; add hint

findings.title: Splat mode scene restore and blob URL lifetime on mode switch unspecified
findings.fix: Keep lastSplatScene state (initial DEFAULT_SCENE), restore on switching back, never revoke on mode switch; acceptance check

findings.title: Pile heights 8–20 cm infeasible with stated leaf counts and stack model
findings.fix: Height-driven piles: r 0.3–0.4, h 0.08–0.15, n=ceil(πr²h/2/(leafLayerM·meanLeafArea)); test max stack within ±30% of h

findings.title: Internal conflicts: A1 vs §10 hook API; forest-floor density; M1 determinism uses M2 template; AC1 button names
findings.fix: Align A1 with §10; forest-floor 4/m² + three r1.5 carpets at 100/m²; M1 sim.test on sample seed 1; AC1 lists actual controls
